Hi Aisha — thanks for the quick response and the signer matrix. Looping in Jordan for billing/PO flow and Kimberly for security evidence.

Notes from our side after a first review of the inputs:

1) Residency and Exhibit: we will prepare an \"Exhibit D: Data Residency & Hosting\" that calls out US-only processing for the production workload and describes transient EU logs retention. Please confirm whether EU logs are encrypted-at-rest under your account KMS or if we should reference our hosted key options.

2) Payment terms (PO / net 60): Redwood standard is net 30; we can accept a negotiated net 60 tied to a 2% processing surcharge or an agreed pre-pay schedule. We will surface this as a negotiable item in the redline.

3) Liability cap: Please confirm your target liability cap (e.g., X months of fees or a fixed dollar amount). We'll propose our standard commercial compromise in the annotated redline.

4) Signer flow: Priya is fine as the procurement approver; we need the legal approver and an initial signature from an authorized officer (VP+). If you can confirm who will act as the legal approver, we'll map the signer order accordingly.

I've attached the Redwood MSA template (MSA_Template_Redwood_v3.docx) and an annotated first-pass (redlines_annotated.docx). The redline highlights the areas noted above plus a suggestion for a residency exhibit and a proposed fallback model (redundant-region routing) to preserve uptime.

Proposed next steps:
- Aisha / FinWave to confirm liability target and KMS approach for EU logs (timeline: 48 hrs).
- FinWave to confirm legal approver name and PO cadence.
- Redwood will produce a short redline summary table (one pager) and a DocuSign-ready set of documents if the changes are limited.

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min triage call Thursday at 10:00am PT.

Best,
